exactText: I actually think we crossed that about three months ago.
sourceQuote: I actually think we crossed that about three months ago.
normalizedClaim: AGI (AI as smart as a person) was reached approximately three months prior to May 2026 (around February 2026).
resolutionCriteria: Broad consensus among AI researchers and labs that human-level general intelligence was achieved by mid-2026.

exactText: Software has been eating the world at the speed of human hands. It is about to eat the world at the speed of compute.
sourceQuote: It is about to eat the world at the speed of compute.
normalizedClaim: Software adoption and transformation of industries will accelerate from human coding speed to the speed of compute via AI agents.
resolutionCriteria: Observable acceleration in software-driven industry disruption rates post-2026 compared to the 2011–2025 period, measured by market cap shifts or process automation metrics.

exactText: When agents write 90% of the code, engineers can literally do ten times as much. The 10x engineer becomes the 100x engineer
normalizedClaim: With AI agents writing the majority of code, individual engineers will achieve roughly 10× productivity gains relative to pre-agent baselines.
resolutionCriteria: Industry productivity studies or company reports showing order-of-magnitude increases in engineer output attributable to coding agents by 2029.

exactText: within a year, it will be normal for each person to have 10 to 20 AI agents, and each of those agents will have 10 to 20 sub-agents.
sourceQuote: within a year, it will be normal for each person to have 10 to 20 AI agents
normalizedClaim: By approximately mid-2027 it will be normal for knowledge workers to manage 10–20 AI agents (each potentially with sub-agents).
resolutionCriteria: Widespread enterprise and professional practice of individuals supervising fleets of 10+ AI agents by end of 2027, documented in surveys or product usage data.

exactText: AI is already a better doctor than 99.99% of human doctors. This is good news.
sourceQuote: AI is already a better doctor than 99.99% of human doctors.
normalizedClaim: As of July 2026, frontier AI systems outperform 99.99% of human doctors on relevant medical tasks.
resolutionCriteria: Peer-reviewed or large-scale evaluations showing frontier models superior to the vast majority of physicians on diagnostic or advisory benchmarks as of mid-2026.

exactText: In the past year, Devin has gone from writing 13% of Cognition’s production code to more than 90%.
sourceQuote: Devin has gone from writing 13% of Cognition’s production code to more than 90%.
normalizedClaim: Coding agents such as Devin increased their share of production code at Cognition from 13% to over 90% within one year.
resolutionCriteria: Company-reported metrics confirming the stated increase in AI-written production code at Cognition Labs.

resolution.explanation: Stated as a factual internal observation by Andreessen.

exactText: If you watch their revealed preferences, they’re all using AI. They're downloading the apps, they're using ChatGPT in their job. They are not only using this technology, they love this technology.
sourceQuote: They are not only using this technology, they love this technology.
normalizedClaim: Despite survey expressions of concern, actual user behavior shows widespread adoption and positive engagement with AI tools.
resolutionCriteria: Usage statistics (downloads, daily active users, workplace integration) continuing to rise while sentiment polls remain mixed through 2027.

exactText: It's going to be every writer, every lawyer, every doctor
sourceQuote: It's going to be every writer, every lawyer, every doctor
normalizedClaim: AI agent fleets will become standard tools for writers, lawyers, doctors, and similar knowledge professionals.
resolutionCriteria: Majority adoption of multi-agent workflows among professionals in writing, law, and medicine by 2030.

exactText: Technology increases productivity → cost of output falls → demand for output rises → more total output gets built → more jobs (and at higher wages).
sourceQuote: more total output gets built → more jobs (and at higher wages).
normalizedClaim: AI-driven productivity gains will ultimately lead to more jobs at higher wages through increased demand for output.
resolutionCriteria: Net employment and real wage growth in AI-adopting economies remaining positive through 2035 despite automation.

exactText: Within our lifetime, engineers will go from bricklayers to architects, focusing on the creativity of designing systems rather than the manual labor of putting them together.
sourceQuote: engineers will go from bricklayers to architects
normalizedClaim: Within the current generation of working engineers, the primary role will shift from writing code to designing systems orchestrated by AI agents.
resolutionCriteria: Job descriptions and daily work of software engineers predominantly involving agent orchestration and system design rather than manual coding by ~2040.
